title: REQ · validateWorld reports unknown scene character ids with a path-tagged issue
summary: Each scene.characters entry whose id is missing from world.characters yields a path-tagged error.
description: Context: validateWorld builds a Set of world character ids at loader.ts L121 and iterates scenes at L128-L159 without looking at scene.characters. Desired behavior: for every scene character at index i, if its id is not in the set, push `scenes.<scene.id>.characters.<i>.id: unknown character: <id>`. Expected result: invalid content is rejected with a locatable issue. Why: authors can find the bad entry.
acceptance_criteria: Given scene bedroom has characters[1].id 'ghost' not in world.characters, When validateWorld runs, Then errors contains 'scenes.bedroom.characters.1.id: unknown character: ghost'
Given scene.characters is undefined or all ids are declared, When validateWorld runs, Then no scene character error is added
